parent_evidence: G18 passive state supervision failed exact and NLL gates; G19 active persistent recurrence improved NLL but not exact.

hypotheses.H20a: adding chronological state supervision to active recurrent states improves arithmetic+code IID exact by at least 1.0 pp and has positive direction in both seeds
hypotheses.H20b: state supervision lowers IID answer NLL versus answer-only recurrent control with memory+list regression no worse than 2 pp
hypotheses.H20c: surface+extrapolation combined exact gain is non-negative and counterfactual both-correct-pair regression no worse than 2 pp

architecture: G19 persistent four-step shared recurrent latent state directly conditions generated answer tokens. Both arms add the same 384-class state head; only auxiliary loss weight differs.
state_targets: four chronological intermediate values aligned one-to-one with the four recurrent iterations; training-only; integer classes cover -128 through 255; out-of-range cases rejected
objective: both arms use identical answer CE and deep answer supervision. control state auxiliary weight 0; supervised arm state auxiliary weight 0.35.
inference: prompt-only greedy generation with strict final integer format; state head is not used by the scorer
